thread:
ci-bot: [ALERT] secret-scan detected plaintext AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID in commit 9f8c... in repo infra-automation.

marta: taking this. Sahil, can you disable CI for infra-automation and revoke the key? @sahil

sahil: disabling pipelines now and revoking the key from IAM console. pausing all deploys from that repo.

ops-bot: Incident INC-20240402-12 created (secrets in repo). Severity: medium.

jordan: running CloudTrail search for AccessKeyId AKIA... command: ```aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=AccessKeyId,AttributeValue=AKIA... --start-time 2024-03-01 --end-time 2024-04-02``` will report back.

lee: starting git history scan + trufflehog on repo mirror. also scanning CI cache dirs and artifact stores for the string.

sahil: runners disabled and runner tokens revoked. also set branch protection to block merges until we gate on secret-scan.

marta: if CloudTrail shows any external IP or unexpected activity escalate to legal and rotate data keys; otherwise rotate IAM keys and cleanup repo.

jordan: CloudTrail shows STS:AssumeRole and S3:PutObject from key in last 72h. IPs include known CI pool and one IP not in our ranges (13.52.111.0/24). Flagging as suspicious.

sahil: that external IP seems like a third-party CI provider. I've revoked the key and created new short-lived creds for the service principal. Also added MFA requirement for role assumption.

lee: re-encryption plan: list objects after timestamp and perform `aws s3 cp` with `--sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id alias/prod-rotation` as batch. Also quarantined suspect objects into `s3://quarantine-bucket/` for offline analysis.

marta: good. owners: rotate keys (sahil), re-encrypt/quarantine objects (lee), repo scrub & mirrors (lee), CI hardening and pre-merge scan (jordan), incident report and compliance notif (marta).

jordan: pushed PR #4002 to add `git-secrets` check + fail build on match. includes example config and masking rules.

marta: add post-incident action to enforce org-wide key TTLs and require Vault for secrets in pipelines. Also review KMS key policies if any roles allowed too broadly.

ops-bot: INC-20240402-12 status: containment in place, investigations ongoing, remediation assigned.

marta: schedule 45m postmortem in sec-huddle tomorrow. please attach timeline and logs to the incident doc. closing only after re-encrypt and confirmation of no further access.

lee: note: added scrubbing step to CI to redact env vars before saving logs and archiving artifacts.

sahil: rolled new keys and updated deployments. ETA for rollout: 25m. will post completion.

marta: thanks team. make sure to run a full 90-day repo commit scan and include results in the postmortem.
